thread:
elaine: Heads-up — after rolling driver 535.86 to west-1 GPU pool we started seeing intermittent P2P disappear on some nodes. NCCL falls back to SHM/NET, throughput drops a lot. Rolling canary hit at ~11:05 UTC.

matt: saw this on gw-7 and gw-12. `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` shows links missing intermittently. Repro: run small nccl allreduce and sometimes it picks TCP.

sanjay: are those nodes mixed-gen? A100 + A10? kernel version differences?

elaine: yes — gw-7 is A100-PCIe (kernel 5.15, driver 535.86), gw-12 is A10 (kernel 6.1, driver 535.86). Some older nodes still on driver 530.41.

camila: infra-bot just posted the canary rollout: `deploy-bot: driver/535.86 rollout to west-1 pool started` — can we pause?

infra-bot: Action logged: rollout paused on west-1 at 11:18 UTC by camila. See runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/driver-rollouts

matt: snippets from gw-7: ```
# lspci | grep -i nvidia
0000:3b:00.0 3d controller: NVIDIA Corporation Device 20b0 (rev a1)
# dmesg | grep -i nvlink
[  2.345678] nvidia: NVLINK: NVLink peer not discovered on GPU 0
```

ryan: also saw NCCL logs showing fallback: `NCCL INFO AllGather using SHM, fallback to NET` and timings jumping from ~18ms to ~120ms for same job.

elaine: interestingly the nodes that fail are ones that were kernel-upgraded last week (6.1 -> 6.2) during maintenance, while driver 535 was applied more recently. Possible kernel+driver combo bug w/ NVLink detection.

sanjay: can we collect `nvidia-smi topo --matrix`, `nvidia-persistenced` status, `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`, and `journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -n 200` from affected nodes? Also `ethtool` + `ifconfig` for socket fallback telemetry.

camila: I'll create a node-exporter scrape for NCCL metrics and enable NCCL_DEBUG=INFO for the failing job temporarily. Can we taint the problematic nodes to stop scheduling high-P2P workloads?

matt: yes please taint. `kubectl taint nodes gw-7 node.kubernetes.io/no-p2p=true:NoSchedule` — will do after I collect logs.

elaine: quick mitigation plan: pause rollout (done), taint failing nodes (matt), revert driver on a small subset back to 530 on one node and test P2P, open ticket with NVIDIA including dmesg/journal/NCCL logs.

ryan: repro steps I used: small allreduce across 4 GPUs on single node with `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVLINK` forced. Intermittent fallback to `SHM`/`NET` observed. I can attach raw traces.

camila: FYI cost impact — jobs hit 4-6x token latency when falling back, estimated extra GPU hours ~120 in last 2 hours in west-1. Flagging for cost team.

elaine: can someone try rollback on one A10 node and report `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` before/after? If rollback fixes detection we either hold driver 530 across mixed-gen nodes, or coordinate kernel upgrades.

sanjay: I'll roll back gw-12 to 530.41 now, will post results in 10m.

matt: posted a quick helper script to collect artifacts: ```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
OUT=/tmp/nvidia-artifacts-$(hostname)-$(date +%s).tgz
mkdir -p /tmp/art
nvidia-smi topo --matrix > /tmp/art/topo.txt
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version > /tmp/art/driver.txt
journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -n 500 > /tmp/art/persistd.log || true
dmesg | tail -n 200 > /tmp/art/dmesg_tail.log
tar czf $OUT -C /tmp art
echo $OUT
```

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-4521 — "NVLink P2P detection intermittent after driver 535 rollout". Attach artifacts when ready.

elaine: thanks. once we have rollback result and artifacts we'll decide: pin driver 530 across mixed-gen nodes, or coordinate kernel+driver matrix with NVIDIA. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:

camila: rolling back gw-12 now, will paste `topo --matrix` results when done.

ryan: added NCCL env map suggestion: set `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=^docker0,lo` and `NCCL_NSOCKS_PERTHREAD=4` for impacted jobs as a temporary measure to stabilize TCP paths if NVLink is flaky.

matt: gw-12 rollback complete. Before: `GPU0 - NV1 - GPU1: X` (links missing). After rollback to 530.41: `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` shows full NVLink mesh on that node. Perf back to expected.

elaine: good signal. Let's keep rollout paused and prepare a full fleet plan: either hold 535 or test with kernel 6.2 matrix across our SKUs. I'll schedule a sync with NVIDIA in EG.

camila: added a calendar invite for vendor triage and put INF-4521 in the subject.

ryan: adding logs to the ticket now.

elaine: closing loop for now — mitigation in place (pause + taint + rollback on repro node). Will update when vendor responds.
